description: This source file implements factory functions and classes for E1 local connectors, including co-located and SCTP-based gateways, with pcap logging capabilities.

classes.name: e1ap_pdu_pcap_notifier
classes.description: Decorator class for e1ap_message_notifier that writes PDUs to a pcap file.

classes.name: e1_local_connector_impl
classes.description: Implementation of a co-located CU-UP and CU-CP E1 gateway.

classes.name: e1_sctp_connector_impl
classes.description: Implementation of an SCTP-based CU-UP and CU-CP E1 gateway, mainly for testing.

methods.name: attach_cu_cp
methods.description: Attaches a CU-CP handler to the local connector.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the listening port if available.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_connection_request
methods.description: Handles incoming CU-UP connection requests, decorating with pcap logging if enabled.
